summary: Battery life does not last through full workday
reviewText: The device battery dies after barely 4 hours of moderate usage. Product description claimed 12 hours of continuous battery life. Very disappointed.

summary: Battery drains quickly even in standby mode
reviewText: Leaving the unit on standby overnight drains over 60% battery. Needs a firmware power management update immediately.

summary: Fast shipping and great build quality
reviewText: Arrived within 2 days. The aluminum chassis feels premium and sturdy.

summary: Severe battery overheating during fast charging
reviewText: When plugged into the fast charger, the battery gets burning hot to the touch and stops charging at 50%. Potential fire hazard!
Please add a low-power mode or battery saver toggle in the companion app to extend battery runtime.
